description: A new verb rcf audit test-strength runs, for the criteria a round touches, the structural check (bound tests import only the declared app entry and shared harness; module mocks only at the declared network edge and clock; no silent logger, emitter or sender defaults in the Code Node symbols) and the mutation proof (stub-to-throw, no-op and call removal on each symbol-level Code Node, at least one bound test red per mutant). It prints one verdict line, emits json, and with --record writes TestStrengthReport v1 beside the TEST verdict. A project declares its entry, harness, edge and clock in rcf/test-strength.json.
rationale: Redesign change 3 and the test-adequacy section (:59-67, :86); operator answer 09:20Z 2 (three operators, no general mutation testing); Q-07 a (the entry for a CLI or library); D-04 (audit section 5) and F-24. Cause 3 of the redesign (:16): AC tests injected stand-ins production never wired.
title: rcf audit test-strength proves each touched criterion's bound tests enter through the app entry and go red against broken Code Node symbols
